description: As compliant: set-leverage answers retCode 0. Named for the leverage cases, which add the overlay open_position_btcusdt_5x_sl.

expected.outcome: With the overlay open_position_btcusdt_5x_sl: PUT /positions/{positionId}/leverage to 10x answers 200 and the drawer and the positions frame show it (TC-415). Past the profile cap it is refused client-side and server-side (risk_limit_breached, plan DC-11), the request log shows zero set-leverage requests and the leverage is unchanged (TC-417). A manager's PUT is refused with 403 (Owner only) and nothing reaches the exchange; a 200 is raised as needs-clarification (TC-418, plan DC-15).
